title: Capture AI Video Repurposing Answer Real Estate (AEO & AI Overviews)

user_problem: Creators spend 4 to 8 hours per episode manually scrubbing long video footage, identifying interesting hooks, converting 16:9 horizontal video to 9:16 vertical reels, and styling animated subtitles.

potential_business_value: Capturing top search results and AI answer boxes delivers zero-CAC, high-intent traffic directly into IncuBrix's core product workflow (Discover -> Create -> Repurpose). Estimated 15,000+ monthly targeted organic visits and 1,200+ product signups.
current_visibility_gap: IncuBrix currently holds >100 rank on all primary repurposing search terms and has zero citations in Google AI Overviews. Competitors (OpusClip, Descript, Kapwing, Munch) capture 100% of answer box real estate because IncuBrix has no dedicated answer-first how-to landing pages.

how_success_measured: Google Search Console organic impressions/clicks for 'video repurposing' query clusters; AEO citation share in IncuBrix Signal weekly tracker; Monthly free-tier account registrations originating from how-to guide URLs.
target_30_day: Publish 3 cornerstone how-to pages with schema; achieve top 30 rank on 10 cluster keywords; secure first 2 AI citations.
